stories.title: Trump tells Iran to make a deal, or he'll 'let them rot economically' or wipe out the regime
stories.reason: The blunt three-option ultimatum, delivered to Fox News as Trump left Camp David early, sharply raises the stakes ahead of this week's UN General Assembly, where Trump has signaled he could meet Iran's president even as Tehran's military vows to retaliate harshly against any fresh strike.

stories.title: World leaders descend on New York as the UN General Assembly's high-level week opens
stories.reason: With the Iran war, the Trump-Xi summit, Gaza's fragile ceasefire and Russia's war on Ukraine all unresolved, this year's gathering of nearly 200 heads of state and government carries unusually high stakes for global diplomacy.

stories.title: Trump to hold first meeting with Venezuela's acting president Delcy Rodriguez since the Maduro raid
stories.reason: The New York 'pull-aside,' set for UN General Assembly week, will be the two leaders' first encounter since a US military operation captured Nicolas Maduro in January and installed Rodriguez as Venezuela's acting leader, marking a striking normalization of ties with Washington.

stories.title: Haiti extradites 18 suspects in ex-President Jovenel Moise's 2021 assassination to the US
stories.reason: The group, including 17 former Colombian soldiers and a senior Haitian justice-ministry official, was flown to Florida to join a US case that has already convicted four men and secured guilty pleas from five others, in what prosecutors called a new phase of the prosecution.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill four Palestinians in Gaza, including an 11-year-old boy, despite the ceasefire
stories.reason: The boy was shot dead by Israeli forces inside the al-Mawasi 'safe zone' in southern Gaza, the latest in a pattern of deadly ceasefire violations that has left the truce signed nearly a year ago oscillating between fragile calm and renewed bloodshed.

stories.title: Nasdaq surges 2% and chip stocks rally as oil retreats below $100 on Iran diplomacy hopes
stories.reason: Markets opened the week in risk-on mode as falling crude prices eased inflation worries following the Fed's rate hike last week, with traders betting that renewed US-Iran diplomatic contact could de-escalate the energy-market shock from the wider war.

stories.title: Intel shares jump 6% after striking a Micro LED chip-packaging partnership with Taiwan's AUO
stories.reason: The deal pairs Intel's advanced packaging patents with AUO's glass and Micro LED manufacturing expertise to target co-packaged optics for AI data centers, extending a sharp rally in Intel's stock as it races Nvidia, AMD and TSMC for a share of the AI infrastructure buildout.

stories.title: China's StepFun launches Step 5, a 600-billion-parameter open-weight AI model to rival OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.reason: The sparse mixture-of-experts model offers a 1-million-token context window for long-horizon coding and research agents at a fraction of frontier-lab prices, with weights set to open in October -- another sign of China's open-source AI push narrowing the gap with US labs.
